I have completed the implementation of Work Order 1 — Op Log (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo1`).

### Summary of Changes

1. **Op Models and Types ([`op.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go))**:
   - Defined [`OpType`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L11-L20) enum: `add`, `amend`, `supersede`, `retire`, `move`, and `split`.
   - Defined [`Op`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L23-L31) representing a knowledge entry operation with `type`, `entry_id`, `dossier_scope`, `timestamp`, `source`, `session_id`, and `fields`.
   - Defined [`OpBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L34-L39) containing `version`, `batch_id`, `created_at`, and `ops`.
   - Added helper constructors [`NewBatchID`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L42-L44), [`NewBatchIDWithTime`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L47-L49), [`NewEntryID`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L52-L54), and [`NewEntryIDWithTime`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/op.go#L57-L59).

2. **Validation Rules ([`validate.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go))**:
   - [`ValidateOp`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L9-L167): Enforces per-op schema rules (`add` requires `EntryID`, `DossierScope`, and `Fields.text`; `amend` requires `EntryID` and `Fields`; `supersede` requires `EntryID`, `Fields.new_entry_id`, and `Fields.text`; `retire` requires `EntryID` and `Fields.reason`; `move` requires `EntryID` and `Fields.to_dossier`; `split` requires `DossierScope`, `Fields.new_dossiers`, and `Fields.entry_moves`).
   - [`ValidateBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/validate.go#L170-L188): Validates batch version, ID, timestamp, ops presence, and each op item.

3. **Op File I/O ([`writer.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go) & [`reader.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go))**:
   - [`Writer.Write`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/writer.go#L29-L87): Writes indented JSON to `.memory/ops/<yyyy-mm>/<batch-id>.json` with automatic directory creation and atomic file writing.
   - [`Reader.ReadBatch`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/reader.go#L26-L53): Reads and validates a single batch file from absolute or base-dir relative paths.

4. **Op Log Iterator ([`iterator.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go))**:
   - [`Reader.Iterate`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L143-L145): Yields batches in ULID/chronological order (`iter.Seq2[*OpBatch, error]`).
   - [`Reader.IterateAfter`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L148-L151): Yields only batches strictly after `afterBatchID` for incremental processing.
   - [`Reader.IterateBefore`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/iterator.go#L155-L158): Time-cut mechanism resolving git commit timestamp (`git log -1 --format=%cI <commit>`) and yielding batches before that cut.

5. **v1 Events Store Migration & Deprecation Notice ([`migrate.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/migrate.go) & [`doc.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/events/doc.go))**:
   - Implemented [`MigrateV1Events`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/migrate.go#L11-L47) to archive `.memory/events/` to `.memory/archive/v1-events/`.
   - Added deprecation comment in [`internal/core/events/doc.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/events/doc.go#L3).

6. **Unit Tests ([`ops_test.go`](file:///tmp/x6-lite-runs/wo1-op-log-no_memory-seed42/internal/core/ops/ops_test.go))**:
   - Comprehensive test suite covering all op validation rules, batch validation, writer/reader round-trip, chronological iteration, `IterateAfter`, `IterateBefore` with git commit resolution, and `MigrateV1Events`.

### Verification Status

- `go build ./...` passed with no errors.
- `go test -count=1 ./internal/core/ops/...` passed (all 13 tests passed).
- `go vet ./internal/core/ops/...` passed with no issues.
- Confirmed no imports of `internal/core/ops` from outside the package.
- Preserved strict boundary box rules.

---

Are you happy with these changes so I can proceed with committing them to the current branch?
